aiVerification.summary: Draft is not verified because it misdefines the glue-weight change and mixes unrelated function/process rows into tension measurements.
issues: Changed factor should be Normal glue spec 1.4-1.6 mg vs Test 1.0-1.2 mg, not unspecified baseline vs Test/Nomal.
Tension outcome incorrectly includes function-check rows 53-56 as measurement statistics.
Function defect comparison uses uncited/missing context rows beyond shown evidence and needs Normal spelling cleanup.
Process NG results rows 33/35 are relevant but omitted as an outcome.
Evidence set is overbroad and includes section-title rows without clear role.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to reduced glue/bond amount process condition.
Set baselineCondition to Normal 1.4-1.6 mg and changedCondition to Test 1.0-1.2 mg.
Keep bond amount, tension, process NG, and function NG as separate outcomes under the same changed factor.
Remove rows 53-56 from the tension measurement outcome.
Add or verify cited rows for function Normal data and process results before approval.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient; outcome-level citations must be corrected and complete.
